full_prompt_en: A lighthearted mid-century newspaper-comic illustration shows two children riding a red tandem bicycle from left to right across a pale blue open field. The child in front wears a simple white shirt and tan shorts, leaning slightly forward to hold the handlebars. Behind, a blond child in an orange-red dress sits upright, the short skirt lifting gently with movement. Both have exaggerated round heads, tiny dot eyes, simple noses, and small curved smiles. Their legs and feet rest on the pedals in an easy rhythm. A sparse dark tree branch reaches in from the upper left, and two little white clouds float behind them. At the bottom, a low strip of yellow-green grass and a few loose black ink marks suggest a path without describing a full landscape. The bicycle is drawn with thin dark wheels, a red frame, black pedals, and simple mechanical details, enough to make the ride clear but not technical. Clean black pen contours define the characters, bike, clouds, and branch; small scratchy strokes give hair, shrubs, and tree foliage a lively handmade texture. Flat washes of sky blue, warm cream, red-orange, and tan provide color, with slight paper grain and unevenness visible beneath them. There are no deep shadows or complex perspective. The figures and vehicle form one horizontal unit in the middle of abundant open space, creating a sense of easy forward motion. The mood is gentle, humorous, and affectionate, like a brief sunny moment in a printed comic strip.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅轻松的世纪中叶报纸漫画插画表现两名孩子骑一辆红色双人自行车，从左往右穿过浅蓝开放区域。前面的孩子穿简单白衬衣和棕褐短裤，微微前倾握车把。后方金发孩子穿橙红裙坐直，短裙随运动轻轻扬起。两人都有夸张圆头、点状小眼、简化鼻和微弯笑容。腿脚以悠闲节奏踩在踏板上。一根稀疏暗树枝从左上伸入，两朵小白云浮在身后。底部一道黄绿低草带和几处松散黑墨痕暗示小路，而不完整描出风景。自行车以细暗轮圈、红车架、黑踏板和简单机械细节绘成，足以说明骑行却不求技术图解。干净黑钢笔轮廓界定孩子、车、云和枝；细小刮擦笔痕给头发、灌丛与树叶活泼手工纹理。天蓝、暖奶油、红橙与棕褐平涂水色提供颜色，底下略见纸纹和不均。没有深影或复杂透视。人物与车在大量开放空间中央形成一个水平单位，制造轻松向前运动感。气氛温柔、幽默、亲切，像印刷连环漫画中短暂的晴天一刻。
style_prompt_en: Mid-century newspaper-comic drawing uses clean black pen contours, simplified round silhouettes, and sparse scratchy accents on lightly grained paper. Pale sky blue and warm cream occupy broad open areas, while a few flat red-orange, tan, yellow-green, and black shapes create the focal cluster. Tiny dotlike marks and curved strokes convey expression and motion economically. Line weight stays mostly even but wavers enough to retain a handmade printed quality; vegetation and cloud edges loosen into quick broken touches. There is little modeled shadow or deep perspective. A compact horizontal group sits in the middle of generous negative space, with a dark upper branch and a low broken ground strip providing loose balance. The visual rhythm is buoyant and immediately readable, allowing color restraint, airy spacing, and small ink irregularities to carry the charm.
style_prompt_zh: 世纪中叶报纸漫画用干净黑钢笔轮廓、简化圆剪影和稀疏刮擦重点画在轻微颗粒纸上。浅天蓝与暖奶油占据宽阔开放区域，少数平涂红橙、棕褐、黄绿与黑形状形成焦点簇群。小点状标记与弯笔以经济方式传达表情和运动。线宽大体均匀却略微摇动，保留手工印刷感；植被和云缘松成迅速断笔。几乎没有塑形暗影或深透视。紧凑水平群组居于充足留白中央，上方暗树枝和下方破碎地带提供松散平衡。视觉节奏轻快且立刻可读，让克制色彩、疏朗间距与微小墨线不规则承载趣味。
theme_en: Two cheerful children ride a red tandem bicycle beneath a sparse tree
theme_zh: 两名快乐孩子骑红色双人自行车经过疏树下
name: Mort Walker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
